qualification.details: Junior Research Assistant (JRA): M.Sc. (Ag.) Plant Pathology/ M.Sc. Botany with specialization in Plant Pathology or equivalent with 1st class in Graduate and Post Graduate. Resident of Uttar Pradesh only. Desirable: experience on Mushroom Cultivation. Lab Assistant/ Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Agricultural sciences. Desirable: experience for research lab and field experiments with computer knowledge. Masters in Genetics and Plant Breeding preferred. Young Professional II: M.Sc. in Agricultural Biotechnology/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Agricultural Biochemistry/ Molecular Biology & Biotechnology/ Agriculture Chemistry/ Agrochemicals & Pest Management/ Analytical chemistry/ Chemistry. Young Professional II (YP-II): Masters Degree in Forestry/ Agroforestry/ Forest Resource Management/ Life Science/ Remote Sensing. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on multiple dates: 7th September 2026, 8th September 2026, 9th September 2026, and 10th September 2026. Candidates should choose one of these dates to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by RLBCAU?
faq.answer: Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU) has announced a total of 8 vacancies for various contractual positions through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the contractual positions at RLBCAU will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh - 284003.

faq.question: Q7. What qualifications are required for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post, candidates need an M.Sc. (Ag.) Plant Pathology or M.Sc. Botany with specialization in Plant Pathology or equivalent, with a 1st class in both Graduate and Post Graduate degrees.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. Candidates from SC/ST categories can avail 5 years of relaxation, OBC candidates can get 3 years, and Persons with Disability (PWD) can get 10 years of age relaxation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Young Professional-II posts is Rs. 35,000/- per month fixed. For Young Professional-II (YP-II) in Forestry/Agroforestry, the consolidated salary is Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
